description: ocsp.rs line 484: the SHA-512 oracle comment shows the hex string as 'ee26b0dd4af7e749aa1a8ee3c10ae9923f618980772e473f8819a5d4940e0db27ac185f8a0e1d5f84f88bc887fd67b143732c304cc5fa9ad8e6f57f50028a8ff' — this is only 63 bytes (126 hex chars) but SHA-512 produces 64 bytes (128 hex chars). The comment is missing the leading '0' on the first byte: the correct value is '0ee26b0dd...' not 'ee26b0dd...'. The hardcoded byte array in the test (lines 487-494) is correct (64 bytes, starting 0xee), so the test itself passes correctly. Only the documentation comment is wrong. This will confuse anyone trying to verify the oracle independently. Suggested fix: prepend '0' to the hex string in the comment on line 484.
title: P4: SHA-512 test vector comment has typo in hex string
